display_name: DURA 噪声门控与源 IQ 相似关系训练
description: 冻结原 DURA，训练噪声门控时变修正，新增基于源 clean IQ 的批内软相似关系保持；无 F、TX 标签、V 或目标。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA v1.0 E20/4940 with independently initialized 28614-parameter time-varying correction and zero heads
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura verifies original7/63/30, training_F_access false, TX labels 0 and target_training false
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed DURA source-only original contract; no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

rows.method: Noise-gated DURA time-varying correction, IQ guard plus 0.2 KL of clean-clean versus restored-clean waveform similarity distributions, temperature 0.5
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.

notes: Original source-only DURA frozen; independently initialized 28614-parameter correction, 5 epochs; no F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target data during G training.
Noise gate thresholds -3.8 and -2.8 derive from previously explored 672-record source pilot, not independent validation; inference only uses current IQ and DURA context.

Each source IQ record is flattened and unit normalized; target distribution uses batch clean-clean cosine similarities and prediction uses restored-clean similarities. Softmax temperature 0.5 and mean row-wise KL weight 0.2.
No TX identity labels or learned recognition features; neighborhood preservation is packet waveform geometry, not a demonstrated transmitter-identity objective.
All seven Phase1 views run and score truth-last regardless of source metrics.
